title: Cut fixed per-command latency: launcher in place, state-only status
goal: Every installed susi command stops hashing and spawning a second 51 MB image when the entry already is the current release (measured 150 ms vs 32 ms direct for --version), and susi status reports state instead of ranking models (no nvidia-smi or publisher network calls; measured 3.7 s before). Windows clippy is clean across all targets.
